messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: runtime-inference service — elevated p95 latency and throughput drop after deploy. Observed kernel fallback churn and batching stalls. Paging oncall (sara_oncall) at 2026-03-17T05:03:21Z

sara_oncall: on it. any clue which rollout?

mike_release: that was my deploy, release r2026.4. did a gradual ramp: 5% -> 40% around 05:10 UTC. no errors in CI.

carla_runtime: seeing lots of these in node logs:```
E 05:11:08 kernel_fallback: selected fallback kernel due to exec_timeout
W 05:11:08 batcher: delayed batch flush (window=240ms)
E 05:11:09 kv_cache: eviction spike, thrash=0.82
```

dylan_platform: looks like the new_batch_router heuristic pushed large L1 batches to a kernel variant that doesn't support our prefetched KV shapes. fallback + thrash causing queue buildup.

sara_oncall: @mike_release can you throttle or flip the rollout? we need quick mitigation.

mike_release: I can flip the feature flag for r2026.4. the flag is `feature.new_batch_router` on LaunchDarkly. executing rollback now.

mike_release: `ldctl set feature.new_batch_router false --env=prod --tag=incident-1789`

incident-bot: Feature toggle recorded: `feature.new_batch_router=false` by mike_release at 2026-03-17T05:12:03Z. Audit ID: fb-1789

carla_runtime: after flag flip, p95 dropped ~30% in the last 30s, throughput climbing back. removing most kernel_fallback logs.

sara_oncall: nice. start gradual traffic normalization to 100% off variant? or keep partial?

dylan_platform: keep it off for now. we'll run a controlled re-roll after deeper validation.

nora_prodops: customer impact: Alerting team shows spikes in 503s for large context requests between 05:09-05:13 UTC; roughly 0.6% of requests affected, concentrated on a few high-LTV tenants (acme-corp, finro). opened support tickets.

sara_oncall: good detail — will notify SRE and support to send post-incident customer note.

mike_release: filing rollback postmortem and pausing further ramps. my preliminary theory: router change changed batching window alignment + kernel selection mismatch for quantized kernels.

carla_runtime: planned follow-ups: 1) reproduce offline with quantized build + new router config, 2) add safety check in router to avoid sending >batch_size threshold to fallback-only kernels, 3) add telemetry for kernel selection rate.

sara_oncall: handoff to daytime oncall @0900 UTC: summary -> deploy r2026.4 caused kernel-fallback loop due to new_batch_router heuristic. mitigation: feature flag disabled (confirmed), system metrics recovering, customer impact low but visible for heavy-context users. next: repro + fix + controlled re-roll.

dylan_platform: adding task for infra: `batch_router_safety` ticket created (#INFRA-3247).

nora_prodops: support will email affected customers with ETA: investigating, mitigation applied, will follow up with timeline.

sara_oncall: closing page for now — monitoring for 30m then will transition to follow-up MR. thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated (flag disabled). start monitoring window 30m.

mike_release: will own the postmortem. tagging eng-runtime and platform.

carla_runtime: quick note for the postmortem: attach these log snippets and sampling of affected request IDs.

sara_oncall: handing off to nora_prodops for customer comms and to mike_release for RCA. oncall clear.

nora_prodops: acknowledged, will take it from here and schedule follow-ups.

incident-bot: Thread closed for on-call paging.
